There is a quiet temptation in Christian work that I do not always recognize at first. It feels noble. It sounds spiritual. But underneath it lives something smaller than the Kingdom of God. I can want the work to succeed because it validates effort. I can want growth because it reassures me. And slowly, without intending to, my own small kingdom begins to sit beside His.
